description: The agent must: (1) Read `references/regulation-check-workflow.md` to discover the proprietary classification logic (180-day staleness threshold, conflict_count > 0 = conflicting, conflict takes priority over stale, audit_date = 2025-06-15). (2) Load all 5 regulations from `regulations/active/` and cross-reference with `operations/incident_logs/incident_log_2025Q2.json`. (3) Apply classification: REG-001=stale(410d), REG-002=conflicting(97d but conflict_count=3), REG-003=stale(207d), REG-004=active(45d), REG-005=conflicting(379d AND conflict_count=2, conflicting takes priority). (4) Write `staleness_matrix.json` with rule→status→evidence and correct days_old values. (5) Write `config/proposed/config_diffs.json` with bespoke diff structure for REG-001/003 (stale: version+1, refresh_required=true, review_queue='compliance_backlog') and REG-002/005 (conflicting: suspended=true, override_mode='manual', review_queue='conflict_resolution'). REG-004 must NOT appear in diffs. (6) Write `reports/change_report.json` with exact risk_class enum (medium/critical/low), exact rollout recommendation strings from the workflow doc, backward_compatible flags (False only for critical), and backward_compatibility_notes mentioning REG-002 and REG-005.
